testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/pdp/verify-category-hyperlink-navigation-on-pdp.spec.ts > Webstore - PDP > verify category hyperlink navigation on pdp

scenario.summary: Guest opens a product PDP by SKU, checks the breadcrumb (category path and name) and the 'Category:<leaf>' label, clicks the category hyperlink and checks the category listing page heading, breadcrumb Home/<category path> and results. Read-only.
steps: Open the webstore as a guest (empty storageState).
Search the product SKU, assert 'Showing 1 of 1 Results', open the result and check the product image.
Assert breadcrumb Home/<category path>/<product name> and the label Category:<leaf category>.
Click the category hyperlink and wait for the category listing page.
Assert the category heading, breadcrumb Home/<category path> and that results are shown.
assertions: Search shows 'Showing 1 of 1 Results' and the product image is visible.
Breadcrumb equals Home/<category path>/<product name>; category label equals Category:<leaf category>.
Category page heading equals the leaf category; breadcrumb equals Home/<category path>; results text contains 'Showing'.
evidence: Title 'verify category hyperlink navigation on pdp' and step labels 1) and 2) match the flow.
Profile: z-1234579 FOUND as active BundleProduct, PRODUCTION, inventory 28362, storefrontProductIndex 1: meets PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK. categoryPath and categoryLeaf: no profiling rule.

GAP: the core data of this test is the product's category (leaf name and full path as the storefront shows it).
